label: Day
_note: Solar day from cyclostratigraphy (Milankovitch precession), all values as recomputed in farhat2022 Table D.1 with one tidal model so they are mutually consistent: Walvis Ridge 55 Ma, Lucaogou 270 Ma (cycle-count analysis b), Yangtze 445 Ma, Alum Shale 493 Ma, Luoyixi 500 Ma, Xiamaling 1.4 Ga, Joffre 2.46 Ga. Present = Laskar 2004 initial condition. Linear between points; blank before 2.46 Ga. Rhythmite values (Table D.2, e.g. Elatina 22.27 h at 620 Ma) are left out because they cross the cyclostratigraphic curve. mitchell2023 argues for a ~19 h plateau from ~2 to ~1 Ga, which linear interpolation does not show.
